title: Natural-index tape marks
statement: For every finite list $m$ of natural numbers and every natural number $j$, the mark tape whose marked cells are the nonnegative integer positions corresponding to members of $m$, evaluated at position $j$, equals the mark-cell indicator of whether $j$ belongs to $m$.
